title: Python ML: Decision Tree
description: A Decision Tree is a flowchart-like structure in which each internal node represents a 'test' on an attribute, each branch represents the outcome of the test, and each leaf node represents a class label. It is one of the most popular and easy to understand classification algorithms.
example:
// Decision Tree Implementation
import pandas
from sklearn import tree
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pandas.read_csv("data.csv")
d = {'UK': 0, 'USA': 1, 'N': 2}
df['Nationality'] = df['Nationality'].map(d)

features = ['Age', 'Experience', 'Rank', 'Nationality']
X = df[features]
y = df['Go'] # Predict if someone should go to a show

dtcree = DecisionTreeClassifier()
dtcree = dtcree.fit(X, y)

tree.plot_tree(dtcree, feature_names=features)
plt.show()
